[b]Serath, 11.11.2025[/b]

[b]Commander Halin:[/b]
High Matron, the confirmation came at dawn. The Premiers staff signed off. Coordinates. Timetables. Theyve placed batteries within range of the eastern wall. If they fire at the citadel, our shrines and the families inside will burn.

[b]High Matron Sera:[/b]
You bring me paper with the smell of betrayal and the names of those who would burn our children to buy their advantage.
[i]*she rises from her seat to take the documents Halin offers her kneeling*[/i]
How certain are you this is not a plant? A provocation to lure us into answering for a false crime?

[b]Halin:[/b]
Two sources. A clerk who we rescued two months ago and the deputy artillery officer who once tended a shrine before his transfer. Both swear. The deputy sent this himself, in secret. He said they call it a surgical clearance. They do not see altars, they see positions. It is true.

[b]Sera:[/b]
If it is true, then Naerim has chosen to strike the sacred. If it is false, then someone has chosen to warp our hands. What do the captains say? Are our walls ready?

[b]Halin:[/b]
The barricades are thin in places. Supply convoys have been intercepted three times this month. The young faithful boys are hardened, but they want to hit back. They want to answer with a lesson so terrible the Premiers name is burned on their lips forever.

[b]Sera:[/b]
You speak as if vengeance is a suitable shield. It is not. I have seen what happens when a people adds atrocity to atrocity and it is certainly not something we want.
[i]*a long silence, yet so loud*[/i]
Still, I will not sit idle. I will not let our people be slaughtered while I offer prayers. Tell me plainly: what do you ask me to do?

[b]Halin:[/b]
Order a strike at his command centers. Send those who will deliver the fire into the very heart of his council. Let our enemies learn that a temple burned is met with a storm. Let them know a people has limits.

[b]Sera:[/b]
Halin, you are brave, but you are broken from too many winters on the road. I know the weight of what you mean when you say storm. But I will not sanction acts that will turn our defenders into instruments of darkn-.

[b]Halin:[/b]
They fire on our mothers and you will not answer? You will let them shell the children and do nothing?
[i]*Halin closes the distance between them and lowers his voice*[/i]
You're not invincible, High Matron Sera. If you wont do it, the people will. And if you hinder them, I will.

[b]Sera:[/b]
[i]*loud audible sigh*[/i]
Send them today. When Premier Onu holds the press conference. They shall die in Aelirs name. And Onu's soul will find no home. I hope this satisfies your wrongly directed desires.

[b]The Express | BREAKING NEWS | 13.11.2025[/b]
[b]Premier Onu, Finance and Defense Ministers Killed in Twin Suicide Bombing[/b]

NAERIM-CITY - The Free Republic of Naerim has been struck by its most devastating attack since the civil war began. At 10:42 a.m. this morning, two suicide bombers detonated explosive vests inside the [b]House of State[/b], killing [b]Premier Kareth Onu[/b], [b]Finance Minister Relin Dahr[/b], and Defense [b]Minister Seran Vel[/b] during a live press conference. At least [b]47 people are confirmed dead[/b] and more than [b]120 wounded[/b], including journalists, staff, and security officers.

The attackers, disguised as members of the press, managed to pass multiple checkpoints before detonating themselves just meters from the podium. Both explosions happened within seconds of each other, the first tearing through the audience, the second aimed at rescuers and guards rushing forward. The live broadcast cut to static as the building filled with smoke.

By midday, emergency sirens echoed across Naerim-Stadt. Entire districts were locked down as military vehicles sealed the government quarter. Acting Premier [b]Arlen Vos[/b] addressed the nation briefly from an undisclosed location:

> The Premier is gone. The heart of this Republic has been pierced. We will find them. Those who brought terror into our city will find no shelter, no sanctuary, no mercy.

Intelligence officials now point to the head of state, self proclaimed [b]High Matron Sera from the Holy League of Tirakan[/b] as the prime suspect. Encrypted messages intercepted hours after the attack celebrated the deaths as divine justice upon the faithless. The Holy League has not issued a formal claim, but allied clerical militias in the northern mountains posted messages online praising the bombing as retribution for the profaners of Tirakan.

The attack follows only a few days after Naerims formal recognition of the [b]Coastal Alliance[/b] and its declaration of limited military operations against both the [b]Renaissance Union[/b] and the [b]Holy League[/b]. Artillery had already been mobilized along the northern frontier, and troop movements were reported near Serath and the Marrin corridor. Analysts now warn that the simultaneous loss of the Premier and both senior ministers could throw the command structure into chaos.

The [b]Conclave[/b] has been called into emergency session tonight to determine an interim leadership and secure operational continuity. Security forces have been ordered onto maximum alert, air patrols now circle Naerim-Stadt while drones sweep the capital for potential collaborators.

Outside the ruins of the House of State, citizens gathered silently as the sun set over the bay. Burnt glass still glowed in the rubble, and volunteers carried bloodied reporters to ambulances. Someone placed a torn Naerim flag over the shattered podium.

He was the idea that Naerim is big enough, said an engineer standing behind the police tape. And now that ideas covered in dust. We will take revenge!

The capital remains under curfew. The bodies of Premier Onu, Ministers Dahr, and Vel are being prepared for state funerals. Naerims borders to Holy League territory have been sealed indefinitely.

Tonight, the Republic mourns, and prepares for what comes next.

[quote=bantarus;60725154][spoiler=[b]The Sinking of the SHH Ansgar Jökullsson, The North Sea, November 10th, 1988[/b]]

[i]The SHH Ansgar Jökullsson left the port of Vetrarhald at dawn on 9 November 1988, her steel hull groaning as she pushed into the dark swells of the North Sea. At 224 meters long, she was one of the largest ore freighters in service, carrying 28,000 tons of iron ore bound for Jomsland's northern foundries. Her crew of thirty-four veterans trusted her completely, the Jökullsson had weathered worse seas than these. But the North Sea had a temper in late autumn, and that year it was vicious. By evening, the barometer had plunged without warning. Radio stations along the coast issued gale alerts, but the Jökullsson was already far from shelter, fighting winds that screamed over the water with hurricane force. Waves rose like cliffs, hammering the bow until it vanished repeatedly beneath black walls of spray. Still, Captain Einar Vilhelmsson reported in calm tones, Holding course. Riding heavy but stable. 
At 20:17 AM, the Jomslandic Coast Guard received a final, broken transmission.
We are taking water port side cant maintain trim
A burst of static. 
And then silence.
Witnesses on nearby vessels later said the storm moved like Jörmungandr itself, attacking ships with no mercy. When dawn broke on 11 November, the sea was strangely calm, as if ashamed of what it had done. The search aircraft found only debris: a life ring, a shredded net, and an oil slick spreading across the gray water. The hull of the Ansgar Jökullsson lay in two pieces on the seabed, 1650 meters down. The High King declared a week of mourning. Families gathered in Heiðabýrs temple to light a fire for the lost thirty-four. No bodies were ever recovered. To this day, sailors crossing the North Sea say that on stormy nights, when the wind howls low across the waves, you can still hear a distant bell, the last toll of the Ansgar Jökullsson disappearing into the deep.

Over 99.2% of the votes have been counted and all voting stations have closed, and with the release of the results they have brought on another five years of Valeri Puteyr as Federalists secure their fourth continuous presidential victory. Valeri Puteyr securing a second term wasn't a surprise, pre-election polling showed an approval rating in the 70s and an emphasis on fiscal responsibility has resulted in large elimination of national debt which was a concern during the Volkov presidency.

Unsurprisingly, the Federalists secured a major hold over Destiny, with heavy leads in Haven, Liberty, and Progress. Federalists and Nationals fiercely campaigned over control of Eden, Hope, and Perseverance which became contentious during the election and saw both parties roughly equal in votes, though by the end of the day Federalists secured a slight lead. The Greens have broken a three decade curse and finally managed to secure their position in Harvest once again, with the Prosperity Party only strongholds being along the coast and the IT sector.

Puteyr campaigned on a focus on global integration and presence in global affairs, a shift from the Federalist's focus on domestic development during that of Volkov. Puteyr has promised to maintain all the previous policies of Volkov, such as maintaining heightened UREV military power and strengthening the central government's authority. Critics have warned that UREV positioning itself more in global politics and establishing their influence may result in UREV moving away from a non-aligned doctrine, though Valeri has promised to not associate or join established alliances such as THEP or EDU.

[i]"We control the most important maritime passage in the world. Much of the global trade is dependent on the White Sea and us holding it, previous presidents have refused to utilise the true potential of this on the global stage. We hold so much underutilised influence that I say it's time now we further UREV's position using this trade corridor."[/i] - Valeri Puteyr said during a post-election press interview, seemingly intent on strong-arming UREV into the global stage and threatening to limit trade capacity of any nation that may attempt to go against UREV's interests.[/spoiler]
